picks.editorial_note: A combined $1B+ commitment from Georgia Tech and Emory is one of the largest university AI investments of the year, aiming to position Georgia as a national AI hub and signaling how deeply institutions are now willing to bet on AI infrastructure and talent.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Emory Invest More Than $1B in AI to Drive State’s Jobs, Economic Growth

picks.editorial_note: A White House-backed consortium uniting 15 universities across 10 states to pool supercomputing resources marks a significant federal push to decentralize AI research infrastructure beyond a handful of elite institutions.
picks.title: UK partners with regional universities in super intelligence computing consortium

picks.editorial_note: DOE's selection of SLAC to lead a Genesis Mission project applying autonomous AI-driven discovery to catalysis research shows the federal government betting on AI to directly accelerate fundamental energy science, not just support it.
picks.title: SLAC to lead a Department of Energy Genesis Mission project for Super Intelligence (SI)-driven autonomous discovery in catalysis

picks.editorial_note: Phase II Genesis Mission funding for Berkeley Lab's MOAT-Core project extends DOE's AI-for-science push into particle accelerator design, a sign that 'Super Intelligence' initiatives are scaling from pilot to sustained national investment.
picks.title: Super Intelligence for Particle Accelerators Gets Another Boost

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's SPIRE project aims to build fully autonomous, AI-run laboratories for photon science experiments, a concrete step toward self-driving labs that could reshape the pace of experimental discovery.
picks.title: SLAC leads new project to build the self-driving laboratory of the future

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's two Genesis Mission awards apply AI to chip design and quantum information science, underscoring how national labs are using AI not just to analyze data but to directly engineer next-generation hardware.
picks.title: Fermilab to lead two new Genesis Mission awards to accelerate development of microelectronics and quantum

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's $20M NSF-funded Nexus supercomputer, opened to researchers nationwide in partnership with UIUC, broadens access to high-end AI compute beyond well-resourced institutions.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Opens Supercomputer to Researchers Nationwide

picks.editorial_note: The University of Arkansas's AURORA robotic cloud laboratory, part of a $20M NSF project, demonstrates how AI-driven automation is beginning to speed up materials discovery for quantum technologies.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: Louisiana's bid to become an energy hub, anchored by up to $250B in planned investment including a SpaceX spaceport and Meta's massive data-center buildout, illustrates the scale of capital now flowing into AI-adjacent infrastructure at the state level.
picks.title: Large tech firms, small startups and universities are fueling Louisiana’s bid to become the energy hub of tomorrow

picks.editorial_note: A $19.2M, five-year Army Research Office award to a UCF-led team to study light propagation for sensing and imaging shows continued Department of Defense investment in AI-adjacent foundational research.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light
